licenseClasses.description: Sources whose current audited license posture can be used in default generated composites when scope and evidence are also valid.
Sources that require attribution or citation but can be redistributed when attribution is complete.
Sources that must be isolated from permissive defaults because share-alike or GFDL-style obligations may attach to derivatives.
Sources that require GPL/LGPL-family isolation or equivalent package-level copyleft handling.
Sources that cannot enter unrestricted public packages because their terms are noncommercial, academic, or research-only.
Sources that may be used only through local acquisition, private licenses, access-controlled workflows, or derived outputs after separate review.
Sources that are known incomplete, mixed, unclear, or not yet audited enough to generate a package.
